correctness.rationale: For every r>=3, exact divisibility B|F follows by three line substitutions. On B!=0, grad H=0 iff all three derivatives of F vanish; Euler of odd degree eliminates the value equation. This yields exactly the pairwise-distinct nonzero F_{2^{r-1}} triples of sum 1, counted by inclusion–exclusion. On B=0, the quotient restricts to a square with t-2 simple underlying roots, each a smooth double contact; H(1,1,1)=1. In local coordinates at each off-line singularity, the quadratic is a doubled line and the cubic term is nonzero on that line via the proved characteristic-two identity and the nonzero factor 1/(abs). Each is a unibranch delta-one cusp. Finite singular locus implies squarefreeness and Bézout plus unibranchness implies geometric irreducibility. Genus and Fq point count follow. Standalone exact polynomial/finite-field checks for q=8,16,32 verify cases and the universal identity. No finite test is used as an infinite proof.
